FEATURES

Features That Power Real Voice Agents

With integrated speech, telephony, and APIs, Bolna provides everything you need to take your idea into secure, production-ready deployment.

Bulk Calling at Scale

Run campaigns with thousands of AI calls simultaneously.

Custom API Triggers

Call external APIs in real-time during a live conversation.

Human-in-the-Loop

Transfer call to a human agent instantly when needed.

Workflow Integration

Easy to integrate with n8n, Make.com, Zapier, and other tools

Multilingual

Converse fluently in 10+ Indian and foreign languages.

Natural Conversations

Agents understand interruptions, reply with <300ms latency.

Connect Any Model

Integrated with 20+ ASR, LLM, and TTS models.

Enterprise Plans

Best-in-class pricing and Forward Deployed service.

100% Data Privacy

India / USA specific data residency, on-prep deployment.

Model Switching

Run each call with models suited best for your use case.
